Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Go-live MAP: Beacon Health POC activation timeline

Hi Maria / Andre —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our mutual action plan (MAP) we pulled together a concise activation timeline for the POC environment so your infra and security teams can plan the work for API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, and VPC peering. Attached: MAP_Beacon_Health_v1.2.pdf and a CSV of network ranges.

Key milestones (high level):
- Org & billing setup (customer console): due Thu 07/22 — owner: Beacon (Andre)
- API key provisioning + environment namespacing: Fri 07/23 — owner: Redwood (Ben)
- IP allowlist and test IPs: Fri 07/23 — owner: Beacon infra (Maria)
- VPC peering prep (route tables + security contacts): Mon 07/26 — owner: Beacon + Redwood networking
- First end-to-end smoke tests: Tue 07/27 — owners: Beacon devs + Redwood CS

Action items for this thread: please confirm owners and the dates above or propose changes by EOD tomorrow so we can lock the sprint-zero schedule. If you want, we can push the peering one business day later to give your network team more runway.

Ben, Jonas — can you confirm the API key naming convention and whether we need any special scopes for the eval work? I suggested the pattern beacon-<env>-<team> in the MAP.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the MAP and getting the environment live.

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0114

Attachments: MAP_Beacon_Health_v1.2.pdf (PDF, 8 pages); network_requirements.csv (CSV, stub)

From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@beaconhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Go-live MAP: Beacon Health POC activation timeline

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear timeline and the MAP doc. This looks good overall. A couple of clarifying items from our side:

1) Org & billing: Andre will confirm the console invite list today; we prefer the initial account to be named "beacon-poc".
2) IP allowlist: we have two public egress ranges for our test lab (listed in the attached CSV) but our security team asked if Redwood can accept a temporary /29 for smoke testing before we finalize peering. Is that supported?
3) VPC peering: our network lead (cc'd offline) needs a list of the expected ports and protocols. Can Ben provide a minimal required set so we can open firewall rules?

If we can get the temporary allowlist and API keys by Fri 07/23 we can hit the smoke-test date of 07/27. Otherwise we will need to move the smoke tests to 07/29.

Regards,
Maria
Director, Platform Engineering | Beacon Health
maria.santos@beaconhealth.com | +1 617-555-2244

Hi Maria —

We can absolutely accept a temporary /29 for the smoke tests; that works fine for short-lived validation. I'll list the minimal ports below for your networking team.

API keys / env naming:
- We'll provision two keys: "beacon-poc-read" and "beacon-poc-write". If you need role separation we can add more. Keys will be scoped to the POC org and expire in 90 days by default (we can shorten on request).

Minimal network ports for smoke and simple workload testing:
- TCP 443 (HTTPS) outbound/inbound to Redwood endpoints
- TCP 80 (optional redirect)
- TCP 22 (only if you request agent-based upload; otherwise not needed)
- UDP none required for the POC

Ben pointed to the network_requirements.csv in the attachments; Jonas and Marissa, please confirm there are no additional requirements for VPC peering (route table entries, ASN info).

Next steps (concrete):
- Ben to provision keys (Fri 07/23 morning) — Ben
- Beacon to confirm /29 allocation and provide CIDR (Thu 07/22 EOD) — Beacon
- Jonas to share peering prep checklist (Mon 07/26) — Jonas

--
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0198

Thanks all — quick status update to close the MAP planning window: 

- Andre confirmed console invites and the org name is set to "beacon-poc" (confirmed 07/22).
- Maria provided temporary /29 CIDR (203.0.113.56/29) for smoke testing — accepted.
- Ben has provisioned "beacon-poc-read" and "beacon-poc-write" API keys this morning and shared the delivery note to Andre off-thread.
- Jonas attached the peering prep checklist (internal) and will coordinate with Beacon's network lead Monday 07/26 for route table validation.

If there are no objections, we'll call the MAP "locked" and proceed with peering prep. Please reply only if we need to change dates; otherwise we'll run the smoke tests on Tue 07/27 as planned.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — excited to get you live.

Best,
Neha
